# Wordwise

> Wordwise is a freelance SEO copywriting service based in Dorking, Surrey. We write locally targeted blog articles and website copy for UK small businesses.

## Services

- SEO blog articles — keyword-researched, locally targeted articles for small business websites
- Website copywriting — homepages, service pages, and about pages written to rank and convert
- Website SEO audits — free audits identifying title tag, meta description, content, and technical issues
- Monthly content packages — consistent publishing for sustained Google visibility

## Target clients

Independent UK small businesses — yoga teachers, photographers, tradespeople, cleaning companies, wellness practitioners, and professional services across Surrey, Sussex, and South London.
